applicant.name: Prof. Daniel Berger
applicant.organisation: Institute for Public Health, regional planning group (university)

purpose: Descriptive statistics on breast-cancer cases per region for a prevention study; we also keep a line-listing for our own quality checks.
question: How many patients have breast cancer per region, and please list each case?
definitions: Breast cancer = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with C50.
Report per region: patients with breast cancer.
Also report, for each patient with breast cancer: patient ID, birth date and the onset date of the diagnosis.
